issues.title: Lemma 1 的空场命题反例
issues.evidence_md: 原Lemma只要求R1/R2。取 $R_j=\varnothing,z_j\equiv1$，R1成立且R2为空积1。但原Definition2使所有中心化交互零，尤其 $J_j(\varnothing)=0\ne1$。PDF15推导非空集合交替和为零时未分辨空场。
issues.impact_md: 原Lemma全范围错误，不能加非空前提；实际无偏置架构零基线子结论另证。Theorem3只分给包含玩家的场，常数单元贡献零，并未被此反例推翻。

en.title: Empty-field counterexample to Lemma 1
en.evidence_md: The original lemma assumes only R1/R2. An empty-field unit constantly equal to one satisfies both requirements, including the empty product in R2. Definition 2 makes every centered dividend zero, so the claimed field dividend differs from its unit value. The page-15 alternating-sum argument fails to separate the empty field.
en.impact_md: The full lemma is false and cannot be repaired by adding a nonempty premise. The bias-free architecture boundary is proved separately. Theorem 3 allocates only fields containing a player and gives constant units zero, so this counterexample does not refute its valid algorithm.

The full lemma is false and cannot be repaired by adding a nonempty premise. The bias-free architecture boundary is proved separately. Theorem 3 allocates only fields containing a player and gives constant units zero, so this counterexample does not refute its valid algorithm.

issues.title: Theorem 3 原全j分式空场约定未明
issues.evidence_md: 全j求和可能包含空场；实数域先算分式再乘零需要除零约定。严谨条件和只在场含i时算分式，含i保证基数正。
issues.impact_md: 这是表达式定义域歧义；完整经典归因条件和恒等式已证，不宣称Theorem3被空场Lemma反例推翻。

en.title: Theorem 3 lacks a printed empty-field division convention
en.evidence_md: The all-unit sum may contain empty fields. Evaluating the fraction before multiplying a zero indicator requires a division convention. The conditional sum evaluates it only for a field containing the player, whose cardinality is positive.
en.impact_md: This is an expression-domain ambiguity. The classical conditional-sum identity is proved; the empty-field lemma counterexample is not presented as a refutation of that identity.

issues.title: Theorem 4 证明的全第一层量词及乘积替换错误
issues.evidence_md: 缺一个输入变量只保证依赖它的孩子沿路径为零，不保证所有第一层节点为零。整个AND积也不能无条件等于指定单因子；修正只使用存在一个零因子使乘积零。
issues.impact_md: 命题不变，按感受野并集和拓扑次序证明R1/R2；完整原链保留在original-proofs。

en.title: Incorrect first-layer quantifier and product substitution in Theorem 4
en.evidence_md: Missing one input only makes relevant dependent children vanish, not every first-layer neuron. An entire AND product also cannot be replaced unconditionally by one factor. The repair uses one zero factor to make the product zero.
en.impact_md: The proposition is unchanged. The repaired proof follows field unions and feed-forward induction; the full printed chain remains in original-proofs.

en.title: Missing receptive-field filter in the CNN interaction expansion
en.evidence_md: For a fixed target, only units with that field contribute. Two distinct singleton-field units with contribution one each give target dividend one but an unfiltered final sum two. The printed equality is preserved; its repair restores the filter derived from the unit transform.
en.impact_md: This repairs the target-dividend expansion for a single model and does not refute finite channel regrouping.

issues.title: 共同gate不推出全部通道输出同时非零
issues.evidence_md: 原句用共同孩子推出同时激活。共同gate确相同，但两个权重给线性值1与-1，ReLU后为(1,0)。因此只能说gate同时开闭，不能把非零输出同步当作group证明前提。
issues.impact_md: 感受野等式及加权有限和仍成立；分组gate掩码律独立证明。

en.title: A common gate does not force simultaneous nonzero channel outputs
en.evidence_md: The printed sentence infers simultaneous activation from shared children. The common gate agrees, but weights producing preactivations one and minus one give post-ReLU outputs (1,0). Only the gate states agree; simultaneous nonzero output cannot be used in the grouped proof.
en.impact_md: The field equality and weighted finite regrouping remain valid. The grouped gate’s mask law is proved independently.

issues.title: scalar AND 与 group gate 数值等价子句错误
issues.evidence_md: 孩子向量(1,0)给左gate0、右gate1；父线性值1时ReLU输出分别0、1。改变gate没有保持同一函数。
issues.impact_md: 仅此数值等价子句被否定；新groupgate架构仍能满足R1/R2及其自身输出的Shapley式，正文完整直接归纳。

en.title: False numerical-equivalence subclaim for scalar AND and grouped gates
en.evidence_md: A child vector (1,0) gives scalar gate zero and grouped gate one. With parent linear value one, the outputs are zero and one. Changing the gate therefore changes the function.
en.impact_md: Only this numerical-equivalence subclaim is refuted. The new grouped architecture still satisfies R1/R2 and the Shapley identity for its own output, as shown by the direct induction.

en.title: Equation (9) omits the output baseline for general conventional networks
en.evidence_md: The paper uses centered dividends, whose sum is the output difference from the baseline. A constant-one model has every centered dividend zero but raw output one, refuting the first equality for an arbitrary conventional model.
en.impact_md: The equality holds for the actual bias-free Harsanyi architecture with zero baseline. The M-count bound does not prove small omitted effects in a conventional DNN.

en.title: Unspecified empty selection and first-layer domain for the smooth gate
en.evidence_md: An empty child selection has zero trace, leaving the geometric-mean exponent without a real-domain convention. First-layer centered inputs precede ReLU and can be negative, so the nonnegative-child description does not automatically include them.
en.impact_md: The training definition and its boundaries are recorded completely. Hard-gate verification is not presented as verification of this formula over its entire parameter domain.
